confirmed: XRP is about $0.99 early Saturday, down about 3.7% over 24 hours, about 15% lower than 7 days ago and about 25% below 30 days ago (CoinGecko snapshot, 3:22 AM MST; $0.9895 last trade on Kraken (Kraken 24h range $0.9775 to $1.0427)). It dipped under $1.00 on Friday for the first time since August without closing below it (Friday's close was about $1.01, CoinGecko), then slipped back under $1.00 overnight (Crypto Times). The 2026 low set in August was about $0.985 to $0.986 (TheStreet, Crypto Times). Analysts cite $0.99 as support and $0.80 as a possible next level if it breaks; that is opinion, not a forecast.

Bitcoin fell below $70,000 on Friday for the first time since August and traded near $67,000 to $68,000, below its 200-week average (CoinDesk). CoinDesk tied the drop to a stronger dollar (Dollar Index above 103, highest since April 2025), CME FedWatch odds of about 88% for a quarter-point Fed hike in December after hot inflation data, the 10-year Treasury yield near 5.13%, and Nvidia's CEO turmoil. Crypto liquidations topped $1.6B in 24 hours, nearly 90% of them long positions (CoinGlass via CoinDesk). US spot bitcoin ETFs are now about $1.56B in net outflows for 2026 (SoSoValue via CoinDesk).

US spot XRP ETFs had a net outflow of about $1.09M on Fri Nov 13 after two flat days: Franklin's XRPZ took in about $4.45M while Grayscale's GXRP lost about $5.54M (SoSoValue via TokenPost). The last day with net inflows across the group was Oct 29. Cumulative net inflows are about $1.79B and net assets about $1.15B.

On the XRP Ledger, the proposed native lending amendment has 22 of 35 trusted-validator votes, up from 19 in mid-October, and the SingleAssetVault amendment it depends on has 23; each needs 29 held for two straight weeks, so neither is live and there is no activation date (CoinDesk, Nov 12). The design offers fixed-term loans with no borrower collateral, relying on off-chain underwriting by loan brokers. Separately, XRPL developers will reset Testnet and Devnet on Nov 25, wiping test accounts; the main XRP Ledger is not affected (CryptoPotato).

XRP Ledger unique senders, a measure of active accounts, rose to about 41,700, roughly 42% above the 30-day average of about 29,300 and a four-month high, though far below the all-time high of about 106,000 (TokenPost, U.Today). Payment volume jumped about 207% to about 1.16B XRP on Nov 9 (XRPScan via TokenPost). Both count activity, including exchange transfers during a sell-off, not buying.

Binance has reopened withdrawals on 87 networks, including LTC and NEAR, and says it plans to restore all remaining withdrawal services before next weekend (TokenPost, Nov 13). XRP withdrawals were not among the paused tokens in its latest list.

At Ripple's Swell 2026 event, CEO Brad Garlinghouse said Ripple's large XRP holdings do not give it control of the XRP Ledger: Ripple runs one of the 35 validators on the recommended list, and holding XRP carries no voting weight (DailyCoin, Nov 10). Ripple does control the timing of its own escrow releases.

Ripple CTO Emeritus David Schwartz said in X posts on Nov 9 and 10 that his holdings are down from a high of about 26M XRP to about 3M, from about 1,500 BTC to 1, and from about 40,000 ETH to 6; he sold about 2.5M XRP in 2025. He cited his own discomfort with risk, said sales are pre-arranged in writing with an attorney at least 30 days ahead, and still holds Ripple stock. He also told frustrated holders there is 'no secret plan' (crypto.news, Coinpedia). These are personal sales over years, not a new Ripple sale.

BNY now supports XRP and RLUSD custody: Ripple and BNY announced Oct 27 that BNY's Digital Asset Custody platform now supports XRP and RLUSD for institutional clients. Plans to let BNY clients mint and redeem RLUSD directly, and a tokenized trade finance pilot with C2FO on the XRP Ledger, are still subject to approvals (The Block, Cointelegraph).

Ripple's November escrow cycle is complete: 1 billion XRP was released at 00:00 UTC Nov 1, and Ripple re-locked 700 million XRP in three new escrows that open in June and July 2029, leaving 300 million XRP outside escrow, the same pattern as September and October (TokenPost, Coinpaper, Whale Alert). That does not show the 300 million were sold.
not_confirmed: The CLARITY Act has not passed the Senate: the 'Senate Banking Committee advances CLARITY Act 15 to 9' posts recycle a May 14, 2026 vote, and the full Senate then failed to advance it 49 to 50 on Sept 15. 'Trump signs crypto bill' posts are false. 'U.S. has signed a bill to replace FedNow with a next-generation payment system powered by XRP' and 'RealToken on XRP Ledger will unlock $650 trillion on Nov 14' posts are false; no such law or unlock exists. '$28,000 per XRP' price predictions and 'if you hold 500+ XRP you might already be a millionaire' posts are speculation with no source. 'Convert your funds into XRP as banks go cashless' and 'get money out of the bank / financial reset' posts are engagement bait with no official basis. 'Whales now control nearly 74% of supply' does not match the latest Santiment figure of about 68.5% for 10M+ XRP wallets. BlackRock's appearance at Swell is a digital-assets director on an asset-manager panel, not a BlackRock XRP deal. No outlet confirms the '$60 billion' or '$73 billion in XRP transfers overnight' posts or the 'Trump met with Ripple' posts. 'XRP hit $37,000 on Bybit' posts have no evidence; XRP trades near $1.20 on every major venue. 'The Fed is being told to stand down as XRP gets the green light' has no basis. 'Reset is live' countdowns, 'QFS card' help desks, airdrops and move-your-coins or message-me-for-a-guide offers fit common scam patterns. 'North Korea's $6.3 billion XRP heist' posts are wrong: the $6.3B was taken from Binance hot wallets across many networks and assets, not XRP alone. 'XRP shorts on Bitfinex surge 652.89% to 468.2 MILLION' does not match Bitfinex's public margin data. 'Central banks agreed on a $5,000 set price for XRP' has no source. 'Explosive Goldman Sachs connection to XRP' is a teaser for a video with no document. 'Bloomberg spotlights XRP in 10 early races' misreads a Bloomberg election headline about House districts. 'Garlinghouse confirmed Ripple will become a major SWIFT shareholder by Nov 24' has no source. '$196.88 per XRP within days' posts label themselves rumors and give no basis. 'Bank of America announces an official large-scale partnership with Ripple' posts are false: neither company has announced one; BofA's documented link is as a connected bank in Ripple Treasury's (GTreasury) software gateway, not an XRP deal. 'Warren says the CLARITY Act will blow up the economy' recycles a May 2026 committee-hearing quote, not new news. 'Trump XRP payment claims, Nov 22' has no source. 'A $60 trillion bank just said which one it wants, XRP or XLM' is a video teaser with no named bank or document. 'Trump has signed an order opening 401(k)s to crypto' posts this weekend are not new: no new order was signed; the pending step is the Labor Department's final 401(k) alternatives rule, under White House review since Nov 5. '99.5% chance of XRP at $3,300 per coin, insane SEC filing' is a video teaser that names no filing. 'Frustrated XRP investors threatening to sell everything once they break even' is commentary, not data. 'Nearly $83 billion in XRP transfers recorded overnight' posts name no source or on-chain tracker, and follow the same template as earlier '$60 billion' and '$73 billion' posts. 'CNBC calls XRP the hottest crypto trade of the year' clips recycle a Jan 6, 2026 CNBC Power Lunch segment, when XRP was near $2.40. 'Kevin Warsh officially sworn in as Fed Chair' is old news: he took office May 22, 2026. 'Fed XRP settlement testing' and '20% XRP burn' claims have no source. 'Former Ripple employee says this is where millionaires are made' names no one. 'ETF clients buy $3 million of XRP, bringing ETF net assets to $1.43 billion' is contradicted: XRP ETFs had about $10.4M of outflows on Nov 9 and net assets near $1.24B. 'XRP Ledger introduces quantum-proof accounts' overstates a draft roadmap design that is not live. 'Senator Van Hollen will not vote for the CLARITY Act' is not new: he opposed it in May and voted no on Sept 15. 'Former Goldman Sachs analyst warns $0.30 is next' names no one. 'A newly activated wallet received $167.7 million of XRP' gives no transaction or source. 'Ripple's founder dumped nearly all his XRP' posts misstate a real disclosure: David Schwartz is a former CTO and XRP Ledger co-architect, not Ripple's founder, and says he still holds about 3M XRP plus Ripple stock. 'Kazakhstan's central bank invested $100 million in crypto funds, including XRP' is half right: the roughly $100M fund allocation is reported (Bloomberg via crypto.news), but no report names XRP. 'Brad Garlinghouse says long-term XRP holders will be very happy, something big may be coming' gives no date, video or source. 'A valuation report says 500 XRP could be worth $1.1 million by 2028' names no report, implies about $2,200 per XRP, and is attached to a token promotion. '$280 million of certified diamonds tokenized on XRP' is recycled from February. 'A former SWIFT engineer predicts a $100 to $250 XRP repricing in 2027' names no engineer and gives no basis; it is a prediction, not news. 'Ripple Mint launches' posts dated this week recycle a July 23, 2026 Ripple announcement. 'Global reset' and 'XRP reset' posts are wrong about the main ledger: the only reset scheduled is for the XRPL Testnet and Devnet developer networks on Nov 25, and real XRP on mainnet is not affected. 'Raymond James disclosed XRP ETF holdings in its 13F' is unverified: no outlet reports it and the 13F summaries we checked do not show an XRP ETF position. 'Trump just mentioned XRP on live television' clips name no program; the only November TV interview we found is his 60 Minutes interview, and no outlet reports an XRP mention. 'Bitwise just bought $13.25M of XRP' misdescribes ETF flows: Bitwise the firm does not buy for itself, its XRP ETF showed no net flow on Nov 12, and the group had a $1.09M outflow on Nov 13. 'The Department of Energy is building XRP Ledger apps for energy trades' is reported only by crypto outlets citing unnamed 'details of the federal initiative'; we found no DOE announcement. 'RLUSD just flipped XRP' is false: RLUSD is about $2.8B in market value versus about $63B for XRP. Details are in the rumors section.

news.headline: XRP price falls below $1 to lowest since August as analyst warns of $0.80 drop
news.summary: XRP at about $0.993 early Saturday UTC, near its 2026 low of about $0.986 set Aug 14; it did not close below $1 on Friday. The $0.80 level is one analyst's view.

news.headline: Bitcoin falls below $70,000 as dollar surges and $1.6 billion liquidated
news.summary: Bitcoin and ether hit 12-week lows as the Dollar Index topped 103 and CME FedWatch priced about 88% odds of a December hike; $1.64B liquidated, mostly longs; XRP funding slightly negative.

news.headline: Bitcoin plunges to $68,000 as Anthropic IPO frenzy adds to market jitters
news.summary: Analysts quoted see no direct Nvidia link and describe broad de-risking, rising short bets, IBIT outflows and Strategy's MSCI exit as pressures.

news.headline: Bitcoin tumbles below $69,000 as Nvidia turmoil adds to Fed-driven market jitters
news.summary: Bitcoin fell 7% in 24 hours to its lowest since Aug 20; XRP lost 3.5%; $1.47B liquidated, $1.31B of it longs (CoinGlass).

news.headline: U.S. XRP ETFs post $1.09 million net outflow on Nov. 13
news.summary: Franklin's XRPZ +$4.45M, Grayscale's GXRP −$5.54M; cumulative net inflows $1.789B, net assets $1.152B.

news.headline: XRP crashes toward $0.99 as analyst warns of another brutal drop
news.summary: XRP briefly fell below $1 Friday for the first time since August (low about $0.9967) before recovering near $1.02; analyst Ali Charts names $0.99 support and $0.80 below. Opinion, not a forecast.

news.headline: Binance reopens withdrawals on 87 networks, plans full restoration before next weekend
news.summary: LTC and NEAR among restored assets; remaining services targeted before next weekend.

news.headline: XRP Ledger AI services exceed 5,400 across more than 190 merchants
news.summary: t54's XRPL AI Hub lists 193 merchants and 5,410 services payable in XRP or RLUSD; about $78,000 in total settled value so far, which is small.

news.headline: Crypto Today: Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP extend losses as bears tighten their grip
news.summary: Bitcoin below $69,000, Ether below $2,000, and XRP just above $1.00 on a ninth straight day of declines; daily RSI near 22. Price levels are analyst opinion.

news.headline: Bitcoin tumbles below $72,000 in pile-up of AI jitters, crypto concerns
news.summary: Bitcoin fell about 4% as Nvidia confirmed CEO Jensen Huang's exit and MSCI set new rules that drop Strategy from its global indexes on Nov 30.

news.headline: Bitcoin falls to 12-week low as Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia rattles markets
news.summary: Bitcoin traded as low as $71,200; Ether, Solana and XRP each fell more than 3.5% in 24 hours, and over $750M of positions were liquidated (CoinGlass).

news.headline: XRPL validator says the only 'XRP reset' coming is for Testnet and Devnet
news.summary: The Nov 25 reset wipes developer test networks after a server failure; XRP Ledger mainnet, real XRP balances and transaction history are unaffected, and holders need to do nothing.

news.headline: Ripple's bank-lending system moves closer to launch on the XRP Ledger
news.summary: The lending amendment rose from 19 to 22 validator votes since mid-October; it and the SingleAssetVault amendment each need 29 for two straight weeks. Loans would carry no borrower collateral and rely on off-chain underwriting.

news.headline: XRP large wallets keep growing through a 30% slide toward $1.05
news.summary: Santiment counts about 343,500 wallets holding 10,000+ XRP, up about 16,800 since Feb 9. Wallet counts can change with transfers and custody arrangements.

claims.claim: JUST IN: TRUMP JUST MENTIONED XRP ON LIVE TELEVISION
claims.who: @Cryptowise357 on X (about 24K views) and many identical copies, Nov 13-14
claims.check: The posts name no program, date or quote. The only November TV interview we found is Trump's 60 Minutes interview, which covered his family's crypto business; no outlet reports him mentioning XRP. No mainstream corroboration.
claims.check_title: CBS News: Extended interview: President Trump on 60 Minutes

claims.claim: JUST IN: $10B asset manager Bitwise just bought more than $13,250,000 worth of $XRP.
claims.who: @Coachtylive on X (about 6.8K views) and copies, Nov 14
claims.check: Misleading framing of ETF flows: Bitwise the firm does not buy XRP for itself; its ETF buys when investors add money. Daily SoSoValue data shows no net flow for the Bitwise XRP ETF on Nov 12, and the only XRP ETF inflow on Nov 13 was Franklin's $4.45M, outweighed by Grayscale's $5.54M outflow. No mainstream corroboration.
claims.check_title: TokenPost: U.S. XRP ETFs post $1.09 million net outflow on Nov. 13

claims.claim: U.S. Department of Energy Bets on XRP Ledger for Blockchain-Based Energy Market Settlements
claims.who: @MackAttackXRP on X, sharing ZyCrypto (also TokenPost), Nov 13-14
claims.check: Reported only by crypto outlets citing unnamed 'details of the federal initiative'. We found no DOE press release, contract or document and no mainstream coverage. Even if real, a development project does not show XRP demand.
claims.check_title: TokenPost: U.S. Department of Energy develops XRP Ledger applications for energy trades

claims.claim: JUST IN: $XRP hits once-in-a-lifetime oversold levels.
claims.check: Partly accurate: the daily RSI was near 22 on Nov 13, deep in oversold territory (FXStreet). 'Once-in-a-lifetime' is hype; oversold readings can persist during declines and are not a buy signal.
claims.check_title: FXStreet: Crypto Today: Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP extend losses as bears tighten their grip

claims.check: False by market value: Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin is about $2.8B versus about $63B for XRP (CoinGecko). RLUSD is a dollar stablecoin, so it does not compete on price.

claims.claim: JUST IN: $XRP price down over 15% in the past 7 days.
claims.check: Roughly accurate: CoinGecko showed XRP down about 14% over 7 days at 3:24 AM MST, and other trackers show more depending on the start time. FXStreet counts a ninth straight day of declines.
claims.check_title: FXStreet: Crypto Today: Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP extend losses as bears tighten their grip

claims.claim: JUST IN: $XRP Ledger activity jumps 42%, with active accounts reaching 41,700!
claims.who: @Steph_iscrypto on X (about 2.5K views) and copies, Nov 13
claims.check: Real number, missing context: unique senders hit about 41,700, about 42% above the 30-day average and a four-month high, but far below the all-time high near 106,000. Activity during a sell-off includes exchange transfers; it does not show buying.
claims.check_title: TokenPost: XRP Ledger sender count reaches about 41,700, a four-month high

claims.claim: CHARLIE WARD - THE GLOBAL RESET - WHITE HATS IN CONTROL - TRUST THE PLAN #XRP #XRPL #Reset
claims.check: The only reset scheduled is for the XRPL Testnet and Devnet developer networks on Nov 25, after a server failure. Mainnet and real XRP balances are not affected, and holders need to do nothing. Anyone asking you to 'move' or 'verify' XRP for a reset fits a common scam pattern.
claims.check_title: The Crypto Basic: XRPL validator says the only 'XRP reset' coming is for Testnet and Devnet

claims.claim: JUST IN: A $1.94 TRILLION financial giant is now on the XRP ETF holders list. Raymond James Financial has disclosed XRP ETF holdings in its latest SEC 13F filing.
claims.check: No outlet reports it, and the summaries of Raymond James's Q3 2026 13F (filed Nov 12, holdings as of Sept 30) that we checked do not show an XRP ETF position. Even if a small position exists, a 13F often reflects client accounts at a broker, not a firm bet.

claims.claim: JUST IN: $XRP Ledger lending protocol reaches 22/29 validator votes, up 3 in 3 weeks. SingleAssetVault hits 23.
claims.check: Accurate: CoinDesk reports 22 votes (of 35 validators; 29 needed for two straight weeks), SingleAssetVault at 23. Posts saying banks 'could soon' lend on XRPL skip that it is not live and has no date.
